summary: Tested the example character pack (characters/_example/Halo Mario) with Python only: no game build, no ROM, nothing downloaded. Added /app/tests/test_example_pack.py with 12 tests. 43 tests run (31 old + 12 new): 42 pass, 1 fails. The failure is that find() prints '1 voice clips' where it should say '1 voice clip'. Everything else asked for works: find() leaves _example out of the characters folder; --character finds the pack with the right name, slug, model folder and clip; match_clip, read_wav and the AIFF round trip work; write_sources gives mrc1_ names and keeps the game's mario_geo_load_body and mario_geo_render_body; the texture bytes are right; the zip holds a valid 32x32 RGBA PNG; the C checks pass; the READMEs are there; git tracks the files and does not ignore them; install --help runs.

minor.issue: Always prints the plural: 'Character: Halo Mario (model, 1 voice clips) from ...'. The request says it should be singular ('1 voice clip').

action_items: characters.py line 126: use f"{len(pack.voices)} voice clip{'s' if len(pack.voices) != 1 else ''}" so one clip prints '1 voice clip'.
critical_code_review_comments: find(): the only defect is the plural above. Skipping names that start with '.' or '_' covers both folders and .zip files, and README.md is left out by the is_dir/.zip filter.

Example C: braces and parentheses are balanced. There are 16 vertices, matching the declared 16 and gsSPVertex(...,16,0). All 16 triangle indices are below 16. There are 3 GEO_OPEN_NODE and 3 GEO_CLOSE_NODE, properly nested, and the layout ends with GEO_END().

The game's mario_geo_load_body and mario_geo_render_body are not renamed: DEFINITION only picks up names the pack itself defines. The preprocessor's '#define mario_geo' does not touch tokens that only start with 'mario_geo'.

Not checked: whether the geo actually compiles and draws in sm64ex (no build was allowed). The layout depends on the game's mario_geo_load_body, mario_geo_render_body, geo_switch_mario_stand_run and geo_mirror_* being visible where unity_character_models.c includes the model.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests write only to pytest tmp_path.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: python3 -m pytest /app/tests -q -p no:cacheprovider. test_find_explicit_example fails until the singular 'voice clip' fix is in. git ls-files shows all 7 example files tracked, and characters/<user pack> is still ignored.
